Short title and Commencement

GOMAL UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
GOMAL UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the Gomal
University Act, 1974
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17126, dated
16‑10‑1996:‑‑TheGomal University (Amendment) Bill,
1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 30th September, 1996 and assented to by the Governor
of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 14th October, 1996
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West
Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Gomal University
(Amendment). Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 21 of the N.-W.F.P. Act X of 1974

GOMAL UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
GOMAL UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the Gomal
University Act, 1974
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17126, dated
16‑10‑1996:‑‑TheGomal University (Amendment) Bill,
1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 30th September, 1996 and assented to by the Governor
of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 14th October, 1996
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West
Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 21 of
the N.‑W.F.P. Act X of 1974.‑‑In the Gomal University
Act, 1974 (N.‑W.F.P. Act X of 1974), in section 21, in subsection (1);‑‑
(a) for clause (v), the following
shall be substituted, namely:
"(v) The Secretary to
Government of the North‑West Frontier, Education Department, or his
nominee not below the rank of an Additional Secretary; and
(b) after clause (v), as so
substituted, the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:
"(va) The Secretary to
Government of the North‑West Frontier, Finance Department, or his nominee
not below the rank of an Additional Secretary;
(vb) The Secretary to Government
of the North‑West Frontier, Services and General Administration
Department, or his nominee not below the rank of an Additional
Secretary;".
